why: The Curator's first option, which asks what the hall is, made to ask about `the Sergeant` instead - the far hall's actor, whose name exists only as the nameplate over its body, in a quest that has not begun when the Curator first speaks. Before the first step of every walk the player's own words name a body they have never seen and nothing has said what it is: the playtest shape, where an option spoke of `the watch` the party had only fought under a nameplate. The option still leads to the Curator's answer node, so the question is answered and only the name is new. It declares no unit: what must not compile is a name in the player's mouth that the play order has not told them.
